Text.Text: The den no longer answers to him. Keep listening to your beast before danger forces you to. You've finished my Untouchable Instinct trials. I have no further work for you here.
Reach rank 50 in Beast Mastery before you take the den trials. Improve your own handling; instinct won't cover an untrained handler.

Handlers in the den drive beasts through noise and fear. Recover their trail slate so we can start taking that control away. Defeat six Untouchable Instinct Adepts in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Grotto Track Slate; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base. I'll give you the Dathomir Grotto Apex Den Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Untouchable Instinct.

Here's the Dathomir Grotto Apex Den Key. Use 'Enter the Grotto Apex Den' in Dathomir, Grotto Caverns. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Untouchable Instinct Adepts, then return with the Untouchable Instinct Grotto Track Slate.

Instinct is moving before the thought finishes. Not fast. Early. Your body already agreed with the ground before your head catches up. Adepts don't have it. They think, then move, then get hit in the gap between.

Every den animal leaves scent on stone it crosses enough times. The slate reads that scent, turns it into trail. Adepts carry it to hunt with. You'll carry it back to me, and it goes back to just remembering.
Six of them, together, loud. They overwhelm by numbers, not skill, too many places to watch at once. Watch the gaps between them. That's where the ground stays honest.
Defeat six Untouchable Instinct Adepts in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Grotto Track Slate; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
You've defeated six Untouchable Instinct Adepts. Let me see the Untouchable Instinct Grotto Track Slate.
That's the record I needed. We can account for the trails again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists use a fang charm to monitor the bonds they keep pushing. Bring it back. Defeat five Untouchable Instinct Specialists in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Resonant Fang Charm; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Defeat five Untouchable Instinct Specialists to secure the Untouchable Instinct Resonant Fang Charm, then return to me.
Adepts push. Specialists surround. They've learned patience is a weapon too, the den taught them that much honestly, even if they use it wrong. Silence first. Then five directions at once.

Fang charm hums against a wrist when something's closing that you haven't placed yet. Old clan warning. Specialists wear it to know when their own circle's tightened enough to strike. You'll wear it a while, coming back. Listen to it.
You don't out-wait them. You move before the circle closes, not after. That's the instinct again, early, not fast. Wait for the strike and you've already lost the only window you had.
Defeat five Untouchable Instinct Specialists in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Resonant Fang Charm; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
You've defeated five Untouchable Instinct Specialists. Let me see the Untouchable Instinct Resonant Fang Charm.
This belongs with the handlers who know how to use it. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the den's training. Recover his apex totem and end that watch. Defeat the Untouchable Instinct Warden in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Cracked Apex Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Untouchable Instinct Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Untouchable Instinct Cracked Apex Totem.
Trained him once. Fast even then. The den made him faster and took his patience in trade, now he only ever fights, never waits. That's not skill anymore. That's a man who forgot how to stand still.
Cracked apex totem marked the den's true alpha trail. He broke his on the day he stopped standing still for anything, including his own clan. Bring it back whole and the trail's honest again.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Untouchable Instinct Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Untouchable Instinct Warden in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Cracked Apex Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Untouchable Instinct Warden. Let me see the Untouchable Instinct Cracked Apex Totem.
The totem is back in our keeping. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four keepers still teach the same methods. Take back the den-mother's token. Defeat four members of the Untouchable Instinct Inner Circle in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Den-Mother's Fang Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Defeat four members of the Untouchable Instinct Inner Circle to secure the Untouchable Instinct Den-Mother's Fang Token, then return to me.

Moving without settling. Never let a strike land clean because you're never still long enough to be hit clean either. It's instinct turned inside out, moved before thought, but moved away from everything, never toward. Empty version of the real thing.

Every den had a den-mother once, first beast the clan ever bonded honest. Her fang token got split four ways so no ring could ever hold the whole truth of her. Whole again, it's proof the den remembers something older than what runs it now.

Scent-language, mostly, each one holds a piece of how the den used to talk to the animals in it before the ring taught them to just run. My own beast spoke that language once. I still recognize the shape of it in these, even broken.

Defeat four members of the Untouchable Instinct Inner Circle in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Untouchable Instinct Den-Mother's Fang Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base.
You've defeated four members of the Untouchable Instinct Inner Circle. Let me see the Untouchable Instinct Den-Mother's Fang Token.
The keepers can no longer claim authority here. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last teacher holding the den. Defeat him in the Sealed Apex Den to finish the hunt. Defeat the Untouchable Instinct Master in Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Untouchable Instinct Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

The ring runs. The warden waits and strikes. He does both at once, and never stops doing either. That's the whole instinct, mastered and turned wrong: never still, never late, never where the ground says he should be. You've been building the same thing in yourself this whole trial. He's just further along it, and pointed the wrong way.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Untouchable Instinct Master fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Mine went still, once, at the wrong moment, against something faster than either of us. I've tracked every fast thing in this den since, trying to understand what I missed. I think I finally do. I just can't be the one who tests it.

Defeat the Untouchable Instinct Master in Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Czerka Base; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Untouchable Instinct Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The den no longer answers to him. Keep listening to your beast before danger forces you to. You've earned the right to train Untouchable Instinct. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the ground.
I'll defeat six Untouchable Instinct Adepts.
What is instinct, really?
What does the slate carry?
What am I listening for down there?
Not yet.
Here's the Untouchable Instinct Grotto Track Slate.
Back to the ground.
I'll defeat five Untouchable Instinct Specialists.
What's different about them?
What does the fang charm do?
How do I fight something that waits?
Give me a day.
Here's the Untouchable Instinct Resonant Fang Charm.
Back to the ground.
I'll defeat the Untouchable Instinct Warden.
Who is he?
What's the apex totem?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Not until I've got my two.
Here's the Untouchable Instinct Cracked Apex Totem.
Back to the ground.
I'll defeat four members of the Untouchable Instinct Inner Circle.
What do they actually teach?
What's the den-mother's fang token?
What carries in these tokens, really?
Company needs rest.
Here's the Untouchable Instinct Den-Mother's Fang Token.
Back to the ground.
I'll face the Untouchable Instinct Master and report back.
What makes him different from the ring and the warden?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What happened to your own beast?
Not until we're ready.
The Untouchable Instinct Master is defeated. Here's my report.
